The isdn4k-utils packages contain a collection of utilities required for configuring an Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) subsystem.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.3 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of isdn4k-utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
